en.title: Dulles (IAD) airport unveils $20 billion transformation plan around United hub
en.summary: Washington Dulles International Airport has unveiled a capital program of more than $20 billion over the next decade, with Concourse E opening later in 2026 and Concourses C and D slated for replacement while Eero Saarinen’s Main Terminal is preserved.
body: The Metropolitan Washington Airports Authority (MWAA), United Airlines, and the US Department of Transportation announced a capital investment program of more than $20 billion for Washington Dulles International Airport (IAD) on July 29, 2026. The program covers more than 5 million square feet (464,515 square meters) of new or renovated space across the next decade, roughly tripling the $7 billion modernization outlined in MWAA’s master plan of May 2025. Eero Saarinen’s Main Terminal stays, while Concourse C and D, which house the core of United’s hub, are slated for replacement.

The first piece arrives within months: Concourse E opens later in 2026 with 14 new United gates, direct AeroTrain access, and new lounges including an expanded United Club and a United Polaris Lounge. Behind it sits an active design-build procurement worth $4.5 billion to $5 billion, known as Package A, covering expansion of the Saarinen terminal, a post-security connector to Concourse A, and redevelopment of the A-B concourse. MWAA CEO Jack Potter said Dulles was the fastest-growing large airport in the country across 2024 and 2025, and that the airport’s aging facilities have been limiting how efficiently United can expand there.

United CEO Scott Kirby said: “Washington Dulles is the gateway that connects the nation’s capital to the world, and this transformation builds on United’s long-term investment in our hub to deliver the world-class airport experience our employees, customers and millions of travelers deserve.” United operates its largest hub in the Washington region at Dulles, and the airline has said the new gates will help it expand its international network. Under a new agreement with MWAA, United and its Dulles competitors have committed billions of dollars of investment at the airport over the coming years, indicating that the carriers operating at Dulles are contributing alongside the airport authority and the federal government.

zh.title: 杜勒斯機場逾200億美元改造計畫，聯合航空樞紐航廈將汰換
zh.summary: 華盛頓杜勒斯機場宣布逾200億美元十年改造計畫，E航廈將於2026年稍晚啟用，C、D航廈將汰換，沙里寧主航廈則保留。
body: 大都會華盛頓機場管理局、聯合航空與美國運輸部於2026年7月29日宣布杜勒斯機場逾200億美元資本投資計畫，未來十年將新建或整修逾500萬平方英尺（46萬4,515平方公尺）空間，規模約為機場管理局2025年5月總體規劃所列70億美元現代化計畫的三倍。計畫保留建築師沙里寧設計的主航廈，聯合航空樞紐核心所在的C、D航廈則將汰換。

首期成果將於2026年稍晚到來：E航廈啟用14座聯合航空新登機門、可直達AeroTrain，並設有新貴賓室，包括擴建的聯合航空貴賓室與新的北極星貴賓室。另一項總值45億至50億美元的設計施工採購案（A方案）已在招標，範圍包括主航廈擴建、通往A航廈的管制區內連通道，以及A—B航廈改建；機場管理局執行長Jack Potter表示，杜勒斯是2024年與2025年全美成長最快的大型機場，老舊設施已限制聯合航空擴張效率。
聯合航空執行長Scott Kirby表示，杜勒斯是連結美國首都與世界的門戶，此次改造將奠基於聯合航空對樞紐的長期投資。聯合航空在杜勒斯營運其於華盛頓地區最大的樞紐，新登機門將協助航空公司拓展國際航網。報導指出，依機場管理局與聯合航空的新協議，聯合航空與其他在杜勒斯營運的航空公司已承諾未來數年投入數十億美元，顯示經費由機場、聯邦政府與航空公司共同投入。
